title: Use Redis for the login session cache
context: Login sessions must survive API restarts and be shared by the two API replicas.
decision: Store login sessions in Redis with a 12 hour TTL.
impact: Adds a Redis container to docker compose and a REDIS_URL setting.

title: JWT access tokens valid for 24 hours
context: Mobile users complained about being logged out in the middle of the day.
decision: Issue JWT access tokens with a 24 hour lifetime and no refresh flow.
impact: Simple client code; a stolen access token stays valid for a full day.

title: Use RabbitMQ for the email job queue
context: Campaign emails must be sent asynchronously and retried on mail provider errors.
decision: Publish email jobs to a RabbitMQ queue consumed by a dedicated worker container.
impact: Adds RabbitMQ to docker compose and a consumer process to operate.

title: Version the public API by URL prefix
context: Partners integrate against the REST API and break when response fields change.
decision: Expose the public API under /v1 and keep /v1 frozen; breaking changes go to /v2.
impact: Route files are grouped per version; header based version negotiation is not supported.

title: Structured JSON logs with a request id
context: Debugging a support ticket meant grepping unstructured text across two services.
decision: Emit one JSON line per log event with level, message, requestId and userId fields.
impact: Log lines are machine readable; every HTTP handler propagates the request id.

title: Use ICU message format for translations
context: Plural rules differ between Portuguese, Spanish and English reminder texts.
decision: Store translation strings in ICU message format and format them with Intl.PluralRules.
impact: Translators must learn ICU syntax; plural bugs disappear.

title: Replace the Redis session cache with embedded SQLite
context: Redis was the only external daemon in the stack and kept the local setup heavy; the two API replicas were merged into one process.
decision: Store login sessions in an embedded SQLite table with the same 12 hour TTL and drop the Redis container.
impact: docker compose loses the redis service; REDIS_URL is removed; session lookups become a local read.

title: Retry webhook deliveries with exponential backoff
context: Customer endpoints go down for minutes at a time and lost events generated support tickets.
decision: Retry failed webhook deliveries with exponential backoff (1m, 5m, 25m, 2h, 10h), five attempts, then park the event in a dead letter table.
impact: Delivery is at least once; consumers must deduplicate by event id.

title: Shorten JWT access tokens to 15 minutes with refresh rotation
context: Security review flagged the 24 hour access token lifetime as too long for a stolen device scenario.
decision: Issue 15 minute access tokens plus rotating refresh tokens stored server side; the refresh flow replaces the long lived token.
impact: Clients must implement silent refresh; a compromised access token expires within minutes.

title: Token bucket rate limiting per API key
context: One partner script hammered the contacts endpoint and slowed everyone down.
decision: Apply a token bucket limiter of 100 requests per minute per API key on all /v1 routes.
impact: Clients receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header when the bucket is empty.

title: Move the email job queue to a Postgres table with SKIP LOCKED
context: RabbitMQ was under used (a few hundred jobs a day) and its consumer crashed twice on broker restarts.
decision: Store email jobs in a Postgres jobs table and poll it with SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED from the API process.
impact: One less container; job state is queryable with plain SQL; throughput is limited to a few jobs per second.

title: Render invoice PDFs server side with headless Chromium
context: The client side PDF library produced broken layouts for long invoices.
decision: Render invoice HTML with headless Chromium in a worker and store the PDF in object storage.
impact: Adds a Chromium binary to the worker image; PDFs render identically to the web view.
